paragraphs: Bava Kamma 82a: Rabbi Tanchum and Rabbi Berais expounded in the name of an elder — and who is he? Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads R′ Nachum and Rabbi Berais.[^1]

notes.text: The whole consulted William Davidson paragraph in Bava Kamma 82a names Rabbi Tanchum and Rabbi Biryais, reporting an elder identified there as Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. It supports these local full titles while retaining Hyman’s Berais spelling. Dikdukei Soferim and its Nachum variant have not been freshly collated; that variant remains Hyman’s report, with R′ Nachum left unexpanded.
